Financial figures are from the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001650372-26-000036, filed August 14, 2026) and match SEC XBRL. Ownership is from the 2026 proxy (filed October 14, 2026), as of September 30, 2026, the proxy published right after FY2026. CANNON-BROOKES: 275,940 Class A and 47,066,808 Class B shares (50.00% of Class B; 42.84% of total voting power), all held through the Cannon-Brookes Head Trust. The proxy gives no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the derived figure is 18.78% of all shares. His Class B holding fell from 48,024,933 in the 2025 proxy, and he now holds some Class A. Relation is co-founder (the proxy calls him 'Chief Executive Officer & Co-Founder'). HOLDERS left empty: the proxy's 5% holders are measured as % of Class A only, a different basis from the leader's all-shares derived figure, and are not converted. They are BlackRock, 11,611,358 Class A (7.35% of Class A, 1.06% of voting power; Schedule 13G/A filed July 27, 2026), Vanguard Portfolio Management (9,950,824, 6.30%) and Vanguard Capital Management (9,082,189, 5.75%; both Schedule 13G filed April 28, 2026), AQR Capital Management (8,822,984, 5.58%) and DNB Asset Management AS (8,077,726, 5.11%). Co-founder Scott Farquhar holds the same 275,940 Class A and 47,066,808 Class B (42.84% of votes) as Cannon-Brookes; he is not listed because the proxy gives no all-shares percentage for him either. DIVIDENDS: none in FY2026; the cash-flow statement has no dividend line. BUYBACKS rose to $1,800.5 million of Class A repurchases. PLAN: null; the 10-K says the company 'currently does not have common stock outstanding or open offering periods under the ESPP'. GEOGRAPHY uses the leaf rows (U.S., Other Americas, Germany, Other EMEA, Asia Pacific), not the regional subtotals.
